timestamp_alignment.alignment_policy: Exact normalized UTC timestamp only; no forward fill, interpolation, nearest/as-of join, or future data. Naive timestamps retain their naive clock convention and are not mixed with timezone-aware timestamps.

protocol.purpose: Research whether a cross-sectional MOEX-wide breadth filter improves the six predeclared LONG/SHORT H1 strategy streams.
protocol.breadth_definition: At each exact timestamp, among symbols with valid SMA50 and 5-bar returns at that same timestamp: above_sma50_pct, below_sma50_pct, 5-bar advancers and decliners. One-bar advancers/decliners are also recorded for diagnostics.
protocol.long_gate: Allow LONG only when at least 55% of covered symbols are above own SMA50 AND at least 60% have positive 5-bar return.
protocol.short_gate: Allow SHORT only when at least 55% of covered symbols are below own SMA50 AND at least 60% have negative 5-bar return.
protocol.coverage_gate: Require at least 30 symbols with both SMA50 and 5-bar return at the exact timestamp; otherwise no trade.
protocol.thresholds: All thresholds fixed before evaluation; no optimization on development folds or holdout.
protocol.execution: Signal on completed H1 close; enter next H1 open; exit at close after at most 12 H1 bars. Non-overlapping stream per ticker/rule. Baseline and filtered use identical signal opportunities and stream occupancy; filtered trades are a subset of baseline.
protocol.walk_forward: Per ticker: first 50% of first 80% is warm-up; remaining first 80% split into three chronological development folds; final 20% evaluated separately. Indicators and breadth use current completed bar and prior data only.
protocol.costs: 5 and 10 bps per side, illustrative only.
protocol.aggregation: Per-rule equal-weight ticker averages and per-ticker metrics. No combined multi-rule or cross-ticker compounded trade chain is represented as portfolio performance.
protocol.holdout_status: Diagnostic only: the same archive and final 20% have already been examined in prior experiments; this is not independent confirmation.

limitations: Finam technical H1 candles, not an exchange-certified synchronized MOEX index feed.
Exact timestamp matching can reduce coverage; no stale-bar carry-forward is used. Timestamp coverage statistics are included.
Naive timestamps retain their source clock convention; aware timestamps are normalized to UTC. Mixed naive/aware source timestamps are not joined.
The 44-name universe may contain survivorship/composition bias.
5/10 bps per side are illustrative; actual spreads, commissions, slippage, borrow availability/cost, taxes and market impact are not modeled.
Final 20% is not an untouched independent validation sample because prior research has already inspected it.
Research only: no production signals, Telegram, cron, secrets, Finam settings or broker orders changed.
